bio: The flagship restaurant of Yuji Wakiya, renowned pioneer of nouvelle chinois cuisine. With “tradition and creativity” as his motto, Wakiya professes a new style of Chinese cooking. The starter, ‘Nine Joys Assorted Appetiser’, is so named because nine is a number believed to bring good luck in China. The restaurant name means ‘once a day, let’s relax, laugh and have tea’. Cuisine and hospitality to bring a smile to your face....
